components.name: Primary Decision Button
components.description: Runs the investigation or records the explicit human approval.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 17px; color: #fbf8ee; background: #92281e; font: 750 12px Archivo, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(102,24,17,.18); transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #7e1f18; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e96957; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Reset Button
components.description: A quiet reversible action inside the document footer.
components.css: .ds-ghost { min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 17px; color: #59615b; background: transparent; font: 750 12px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-ghost:hover { color: #202927; background: #ddd6c7; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e96957; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Execution Mode Badge
components.description: Static execution context, deliberately not styled as a selector.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #4c4d47; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 11px; color: #c5c6bd; background: transparent; font: 400 12px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-mode-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 2px solid #83b79a; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Revision Packet
components.description: The dominant physical document surface for one investigated change.
components.html:
zod 3.23.8 → 4.1.5

The version bump is small. The contract change is not.
components.css: .ds-sheet { max-width: 760px; min-height: 320px; border-radius: 3px 14px 14px 3px; padding: 32px 42px; color: #202927; background: #f3efe4; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0 0 20px; font: 720 36px/1.08 'Source Serif 4', serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-sheet p { max-width: 68ch; font: 400 16px/1.62 'Source Serif 4', serif; }

components.name: Evidence Tabs
components.description: A ruled document index with one vermilion proof underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c3b5; } .ds-tab { border: 0; padding: 14px 0 12px; color: #5c635d; background: transparent; font: 650 12px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-active { color: #202927; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #c33a2c; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e96957; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Human Approval Stamp
components.description: One object that transitions from required sign-off to local approval.
components.css: .ds-stamp { border: 2px dashed rgba(146,40,30,.62); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 12px 6px; color: rgba(146,40,30,.9); background: transparent; font: 850 16px/.9 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; transform: rotate(-7deg); transition: opacity 220ms ease, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-stamp:hover { transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1.04); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e96957; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stamp small { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .14em; }

components.name: Investigation Stage
components.description: A named evidence step with line anchor, icon position, and measured detail.
components.css: .ds-stage { min-height: 74px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #b7b8af; font: 700 12px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-anchor { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid #62645d; border-radius: 50%; background: #171816; } .ds-stage small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #a0a199; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.overview: DepSherpa treats dependency work as a document that must earn a signature. A dark, quiet workbench recedes behind one warm revision packet; proof marks, ruled evidence, and a side-thread of checks turn an abstract agent run into something a maintainer can inspect.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant paper surface against a carbon workspace.
Vermilion reserved for proof marks and decisive actions.
Blue pencil denotes retained evidence; green denotes verified approval.
Serif concludes, sans operates, and mono measures.
State is named in text and shape, never color alone.

rules.name: The Proof-Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved for the active investigation, a correction, or the human decision; it never becomes ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Named-State Rule
rules.body: Every colored status also has a text label, icon, line state, or border pattern.

rules.name: The Three-Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif concludes, sans operates, mono measures; do not swap their jobs for decoration.

rules.name: The Packet-First Rule
rules.body: Supporting navigation and telemetry may move, but the active change packet remains the largest and earliest surface.

rules.name: The Desk-Surface Rule
rules.body: Only physical layers—paper over desk and decisive control over paper—receive elevation.

dos: Do make the evidence packet the primary surface before adding supporting telemetry.
Do attach every recommendation to a source, command, patch, or explicit uncertainty.
Do preserve text labels and geometric cues for every colored state.
Do keep mono type confined to code, commands, versions, dates, and measurements.
Do keep mobile navigation in document flow so evidence is never obscured.
donts: Don't turn the application into a grid of equal dashboard cards.
Don't spend vermilion on passive decoration or generic emphasis.
Don't use approval green before verification and human action are complete.
Don't show controls that look operable without implementing or disabling them.
Don't imply a branch, pull request, or message exists unless an external write actually occurred.
